lines.text: BRRR! A chilly breeze blows into the park, and look at your arms!
Thousands of tiny bumpy dots pop up, making your skin look like a goose!
Underneath every single hair on your arm sits a microscopic muscle!
When your skin senses cold temperatures, these muscles yank upward!
This pulls your arm hairs straight up like tiny radio antennas!
For furry animals like bears and cats, puffed-up fur traps pockets of warm air!
And when a cat is scared, puffed fur makes them look twice as big and scary!
Humans don't have thick fur anymore, but our ancient body reflex still works!
Discover your body's hidden codes—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
